text:
Hodan Ali, night clerk, scrawled this on a cooler log after the ward fridge died in Mogadishu. Baraarug Cold Chain had gone before she came on duty. Printed total 186.40 sits by the slip date 14/03/2026. She crossed out an older 90.00 that still shows under code MX-2194. Nobody wrote an insurer reference. Mahadsanid is jammed under the figures.
STAMP: WARD DESK. The skipping pen left ther
mostat on two lines. She pinned the log with a bent clip and left the carbon in the drawer.

total.instruction: Printed total on the cooler slip

text:
The garage book is a mess of diesel fingerprints. Khadra Ismail keeps it for the yard in Hargeisa, and Yard Diesel Works is the vendor this round. They dated the note 2 April 2026 and allowed 21 days of credit. Three charge phrases are underlined: injector cleaning, gasket set, and road call. A separate printed fee of 640.75 sits in the corner. The old quote 410.00 under code HG-7731 stays unmarked. Fadlan is scrawled by the stamp.
STAMP: YARD OFFICE. Carbon smeared the word invo
ice. The square for the last credit day is still blank.

charges.instruction: Each charge phrase underlined on the garage note

fee.instruction: Printed fee kept apart from the charge phrases

pay_by.instruction: Issue date plus the credit days

issued.instruction: Date the garage note was issued

text:
Pinned above the bursar desk: a faint supply note that Samira Abdalla filed for the school in Khartoum. Reed Paper Desk charged a fee of 75.25. The issue date is 2027-01-18 and the credit window is 12 days. She hunted for a purchase order and found the box empty. A carbon underneath still reads 22.00 beside code OLD-3301. Shukran is dotted in the margin.
STAMP: BURSAR. The faint copy splits deliv
ery. The due square on the form was left empty, and the ribbon is dry.

settle.instruction: Issue date plus the credit days

fee.instruction: Fee printed by the paper vendor

text:
Ferry card, written by Wani Ladu while the water stood high in Juba. Pontoon Welders put 7 hours at 18.50 on the card and want the gate locked at 4:15 pm. The card date is 19/06/2026. Three job phrases are ticked: hull patch, valve grind, and paint seal. A rejected quote of 200.00 under code JW-5520 is still on the nail. Tamam, he added.
STAMP: JETTY DESK. River mud crosses pon
toon. The labour box at the foot of the card is an empty stroke.

lock_at.instruction: Time they want the gate locked

jobs.instruction: Each job phrase ticked on the card

text:
Linen day at the small guesthouse. Nabirye Prossy checked the bundle from Basket Linen Co while rain tapped the roof in Kampala. Gross on the slip is 980.00 and the stapled credit is 125.40. The van was signed in at 3 April 2026 9:05 am. A different date, the deposit day, reads 28/03/2026. An old balance of 700.00 and code KN-1184 stayed in the drawer. Webale sits under her signature.
STAMP: FRONT DESK. A crease splits bund
le. The balance line is only a blank stroke.

arrived.instruction: When the linen van was signed in

deposit.instruction: Deposit date written apart from the arrival

text:
Dawn delivery. Immaculee Nshimirimana checked the crates for her cafe in Bujumbura before the shutters were up. Roast Cart listed milk crate at 36.20, charcoal sack at 14.75, and sugar tin at 8.40. The slip date is 2026-11-05. A prior bill of 44.00 coded BR-2906 is taped to the fridge. Merci, then a smear.
STAMP: CAFE TILL. Coffee made a sme
ar under the date. The till tape stops after those three prices.

lines.instruction: Each goods phrase on the delivery

text:
Window job at the clinic. Rehema Mwakasege, stores clerk, noted the visit in Dodoma after the pane came out. Bahari Pane Shop charged 312.80 on 7 August 2026. She wants two phrases kept: pane cut and putty bead. The warranty card was never attached. An old quote of 150.00 under code DG-8044 is still in the folder. Ahsante is written very small.
STAMP: STORES. Glass dust covers win
dow. She tucked the note into the stores tray.

fee.instruction: Charge printed for the glazing visit

text:
Parish bench. Euphrasie Nzeyimana recorded the timber in Gitega after morning prayer. Forest Timber billed 5 hours at 22.40. The note date, also the start of the credit window, is 09/02/2027, and they allowed 10 days. The labour box is blank, and so is the final day. An earlier scrap still says 80.00 beside code GT-6612. Urakoze sits under a thumbprint.
STAMP: PARISH OFFICE. A splinter sits in tim
ber. She folded the scrap into the book.

settle.instruction: Note date plus the allowed days

issued.instruction: Date on the timber note, where the credit window starts

text:
The boat was still rocking. Lalaina Rakoto, chandler, wrote the net bill in Toamasina with wet hands. Harbour Nets showed gross 460.25 less a credit of 75.00. Closing time on the docket is 16:40 and the date is 11/09/2026. Four phrases are ringed: net mend, float swap, rope coil, and hook pack. Misaotra is dashed beside the stain. Old balance 210.00 and code TM-9033 were not reused.
STAMP: QUAY DESK. Salt blurred doc
ket. The remainder line was left empty.

lines.instruction: Each phrase ringed on the docket

text:
Night desk. Fara Rasoanaivo took the ice note in Mahajanga after the lobby went quiet. Faniry Ice Plant left 27.80 for the blocks and 63.15 for the extra run. The truck was logged at 2026-07-22T08:15. No tax pin was printed on the sheet. A prior slip of 40.00 coded MJ-1180 is tucked underneath. Veloma is circled twice.
STAMP: NIGHT DESK. A wet ova
l marks the page where the ice sat. The two figures were never added.

logged.instruction: When the ice truck was logged

text:
Pharmacy order. Naouirou Mouhamed filed the bill in Mamoudzou between customers. Shisiwa Lab Supply printed 54.90 and dated it 4 April 2026. The lines to copy are vial trays, glove box, and label roll. Just that one fee is printed, with no extra sums in the margin. An old figure of 30.00 under code MY-2276 is only a leftover. Marahaba is in pencil.
STAMP: PHARMACY. A sta
ple bites the corner. He slid it into the morning folder.

fee.instruction: Fee printed on the pharmacy bill

text:
Cooperative book. Subira Hamad kept the loft note in Pemba after the tide turned. Dhow Sail Loft charged 6 hours at a rate of 35. They opened the job on 2026-05-03 and closed the book on 20 May 2026. A separate receipt date is 02/02/2026. The labour box is empty, and the day-count space is only a dash. An old quote of 150.00 under code PB-8840 sits unmarked. Asante sana, in the corner.
STAMP: LOFT BENCH. Ta
r sticks on the thumbprint. She closed the ledger on that.

issued.instruction: Receipt date printed apart from the job dates

waited.instruction: Days from the opening date to the closing date

text:
After the morning rus
h in Kisumu, Atieno Odhiambo wrote up the stall note. Jetty Crate Repair dated the card 26/08/2026 and gave 9 days to pay. The printed charge is 228.60. Three phrases are ticked: crate band, hinge pin, and lid latch. The pay-by square is still empty. An old repair of 95.00 and code KS-3308 remain in pencil. Erokamano is underlined.
STAMP: MARKET DESK. Fish smell clings to the paper. She tucked the card under the scale.

pay_by.instruction: Card date plus the days to pay

fee.instruction: Printed charge on the crate card

lines.instruction: Each phrase ticked on the card

issued.instruction: Date on the crate card, where the pay window starts

text:
Planes were loud over the canteen. Namuli Esther reconciled the delivery note in Entebbe while the lunch queue waited. Canopy Fresh wrote gross 1500.00 and a credit of 240.50. The only date on the slip is 18 April 2026. No flight coupon was clipped to the page. An earlier figure of 800.00 and code EB-6710 sits unmarked in the margin. Webale nnyo is squeezed along the bottom.
STAMP: CANTEEN. A gra
vy spot sits near the stamp. The balance stroke is blank.

Stones idle. Wafula Okello, mill clerk, listed spares in Jinja while the wheel sat still. Source Spares wrote 12.25, 9.80, 41.10, and 6.05, beside main bearing, drive belt, grease tin, and shim pack. The card date is 2026-10-14. The column stops after those four prices. Last month was 55.00 under code JN-4419. Mwebale, he added, with a tired tick.
STAMP: MILL OFFICE. Gre
ase shines on the bottom edge. He clipped the card to the mill log.

parts.instruction: Each spare phrase on the card

text:
Bulletin night. Adoch Laker booked the print run in Gulu after the generator coughed. Radio Print Shed wants the proofs back by 11:20. The docket date is 15/01/2027 and the charge to copy is 88.35. Three phrases are boxed: poster run, ink drum, and staple box. An older job of 40.00 under code GL-2205 is not this bill. Apwoyo sits beside a smudge.
STAMP: RADIO DESK. Ink marks the bul
letin note. She left the docket on the announcer's chair.

proofs.instruction: Time the proofs are wanted back

fee.instruction: Charge to copy from the docket

lines.instruction: Each phrase boxed on the docket

text:
Lodge van in the yard. Lekishon Mollel left a bench note in Arusha once the engine cooled. Lodge Brake Bench logged the arrival as 8 June 2026 7:45 am. Labour on the card is 4 hours at 31.25. The claim form was missing from the folder. An earlier quote of 90.00 coded AR-5562 is only a leftover in the corner. Sawa is written under the grease.
STAMP: WORKSHOP. The cla
mp bit the corner of the card. The labour line underneath is empty.

arrived.instruction: When the lodge van was logged

text:
Oxygen file. Zawadi Bisimwa, clinic accountant, reviewed the note in Bukavu with the window open. Lungo Oxygen put the service date at 03/03/2026. Credit starts 2026-03-11 and runs 15 days. Gross 320.40 has a credit of 45.15 against it. Phrases to keep: cylinder rent, mask hose, and gauge test. The balance line is blank, and so is the last credit day. A faint old balance of 190.00 and code BK-7782 remain. Merci bien.
STAMP: ACCOUNTS. The fo
ld is worn white. She slid the note back into the oxygen file.

settle.instruction: Credit start date plus the stated days

served.instruction: Service date copied from the oxygen note

lines.instruction: Each phrase to keep from the note

text:
Lab cupboard. Baraka Muhindo copied a glass slip for the school in Goma before the afternoon class. Bench Glass printed 47.60. Two dates are written out: ordered 2027-02-09 and delivered 21 March 2027. The donor-code box was left blank. A faded receipt of 15.00 under code GM-9091 is not this order. Asante is written in a tiny hand.
STAMP: LAB STORE. Cha
lk dust sits in the margin. He pinned the slip inside the cupboard door.

fee.instruction: Amount printed on the glass slip

text:
Between batches. Sifa Kavira noted a tin repair in Butembo while the oven ticked. Yeast Tin Works charged 3 hours at 16.75. The card date is 29/11/2026. Two phrases are circled: tin lining and yeast tray. Pickup is 6:50 pm. The labour box is blank. An old batch figure of 24.00 under code BT-3636 is a leftover. Karibu, she added, then wiped her hands.
STAMP: BAKEHOUSE. Flo
ur gathers in the crease. The card went onto the nail by the mixer.

lines.instruction: Each phrase circled on the card

text:
Night handover from Amina Kalala at the pump shed in Lubumbashi. Relief stayed 6.5 hours on the suction watch and the posted rate is 18.40 francs, with the wage line left blank for payroll. Callout date is 7 March 2026. Ticket LB-3370 is still chalked from another pump, so leave that old number alone. STAMP: NIGHT DESK. The carbon tore overti
me across the fold. Vu et noté before the dawn crew takes the keys. I signed under the stair lamp after the breeze dropped and the pump lost prime. No insurer reference was copied onto this slip.

insurer.instruction: Insurer reference copied onto the slip

text:
Joseph Ilunga closed the central depot in Mbuji-Mayi with three parts on the bench: split casing, bent shaft, and a seized gland. He booked 4.25 hours at 32.80 and left the multiplication for payroll. Sheet date 2026/08/14. A faded quote of 96.15 from an older sheet is still pinned above the hatch. STAMP: HELD. The carbon split replac
ement, so read that as replacement. à suivre once the fitter signs. I wrote the last line under the doorway lamp because the hatch light kept flickering.

Grace Tshibanda handed the yard office in Kananga over with gate chain, spare radio, and blue tarp. Gross on the chit is 540.80 and the credit slip says 73.35. The window runs from 2026/01/06 to 2026/02/02. Someone pencilled 402.10 on the tin from a closed job. STAMP: YARD CLERK. The fold split handov
er. Reste ouvert until the chain is rehung. She wiped mud off the pen before signing, and the yard was soft from the rain.

window.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text:
Patrick Mukendi checked the berm camp crate in Tshikapa and left clay sample, torn map, red flag, and an empty jerrycan. The log date is 22 June 2026. Docket TS-441 belongs to the previous crew and stays off this count. The live permit code was never written on this page. STAMP: BERM. The pencil split sam
ple on the label. Pour mémoire, he folded the map twice so the damp corner would not smear the date. The berm was quiet after the truck left, just insects and the radio hiss.

kit.instruction: Each thing left in the crate

logged.instruction: Log date on the crate note

text:
Gate copy from Esther Mwamba at the crusher pad in Kolwezi. The outage opened 02/11/2026 and the pad was signed back 21/11/2026. Job code on the chit is KW-552. The board still quotes KW-308 from an older crusher stop. STAMP: GATE. Dust settled on the ink, and a tear split crus
her on the carbon. Vu au portail. She shook the dust off the sheet before clipping it up, and she left the day gap for the clerk to work out from the two dates.

closed_on.instruction: Date the pad was signed back

gap.instruction: Days from the open date to the sign-back

job.instruction: Job code on the gate chit

text:
Stores slip from David Ngoy in the acid warehouse, Likasi. He tagged copper bush, oiled rag, and short bolt. The three charges are 42.15, 18.60, and 7.40. Entry date 9/12/2026. A prior sheet still says 51.40 and should not be copied forward. STAMP: STORES. The stamp edge split ware
house. à classer with the night bundle. He kept the oiled rag off the fresh ink so the tags would stay readable. The aisle smelled sharp and he left the door ajar.

Blotter from the quay office, Chantal Bamba, Matadi. The wharf fee printed on the chit is 64.30 francs. The vessel moved at 2026-04-18T16:05. The paper date under the stamp is April 3, 2026. An old fee of 29.75 is scribbled beside the blotter from a cancelled call. STAMP: QUAY. A tear left blan
k where a lane code might have sat. Copie conforme. She held the blotter down when the wind lifted the corner. No lane code is written on this copy.

fee.instruction: Wharf fee printed on the chit

text:
Watch card from Serge Mavungu at the gatehouse in Boma. Night watch ran 5.5 hours at 21.20, and the wage line is still empty. Relief is due at 7:15 am. Card date 2026-10-22. He left coil of rope, wet chart, and spare lamp. An old extension of 80.05 is pinned above the desk. STAMP: GATEHOUSE. The carbon split wat
ch. Fin de garde. He wrote slowly because mosquitoes kept crowding the bulb. The rope was still damp from the night rain.

Nadine Okemba at the wharf shed in Pointe-Noire. Gross ticket 860.40 less credit 125.15, remainder left off the page. The count starts 11/02/2027 and runs 18 days, and she did not ink the landing day. Copy date on the folder is 4 May 2027. Shelf holds hose reel and paint tin. A faded sticker still shows 610.00. STAMP: WHARF. The perforation split cre
dit. Sous réserve. She blotted the salt spots before they reached the lower lines.

pay_by.instruction: Start date plus the stated days

text:
Bruno Moukoko, rail shed, Dolisie. Two charges only, 88.75 and 36.20, and he did not add them here. Filed 19 August 2026. The bin holds brake block, oil can, and bent pin. A sticker still reads 70.10 from an earlier haul. The live wagon code is not on this note. STAMP: RAIL. A crease split bro
ken across the margin. Bon pour dépôt. He peeled the carbon off his wrist and wrote the bin line again. Heat in the shed made the carbon stick.

Clarisse Moussavou closed the mill cage note in Franceville. The stop began 2026-05-04 and the cage was released 2026-05-31. The filing date on the sleeve is 02/06/2026. Job code reads FV-88. Tag FV-14 hangs on the wrong hook from an earlier stop. STAMP: MILL. The roller split relea
sed on the carbon. Arrêt noté. She waited until the cage door stopped ringing before she signed, and she left the length of the stop for the office.

gap.instruction: Days from the stop to the release

filed.instruction: Filing date copied on the sleeve

text:
Herve Nguema tallied the timber scale in Oyem. He counted resin drum, cloth filter, glass rod, and spare lid. Time on the scale was 6.5 hours at 18 francs, and the wage line is blank. Slip date 3/10/2027. Old tally OY-64 is painted on the beam from last season. STAMP: SCALE. Ink split fil
ter. Compte non fait. He brushed sawdust off the beam so the pencil would not skip. The beam was sticky with resin and the pencil dragged.

stock.instruction: Each thing counted on the scale

text:
Solange Minko reopened the customs cage file in Bitam. Fee copied from the docket is 250.00. This copy is dated 3 November 2026. The hold clock shows a start of 28/06/2026 and a run of 9 days. A cancelled lot still shows 188.40. STAMP: CAGE. No bond code was left on the slip. The rub split bon
d where that code had been. En attente. She read the docket aloud once because the fan was rattling. The copy is smudged along one edge but the figures are clear.

release.instruction: Hold start plus the stated days

text:
Fabrice Ndong packed the pump house bag in Mouila. Inside were river gauge, wet logbook, and yellow buoy. The reading was taken February 8, 2027. Tag MO-12 on the hook is from the dry season and is not the live tag. The live tag was never written on this page. STAMP: PUMP. A fold split gau
ge on the label. Niveau lu. He dried the gauge cord on his sleeve before packing the bag, and the frogs were loud on the bank.

bag.instruction: Each thing in the night bag

text:
Irene Bouanga wrote the clinic tent card in Tchibanga. Gross 990.00 minus credit 214.35, and she left the difference off the card. Arrival was logged 21 January 2027 09:40. Kit list: saline pack, gauze roll, and splint. A stale gross of 512.20 sits in the margin from another patient. STAMP: CLINIC. The carbon split arri
val. Soin noté. She steadied the lamp so the arrival line would stay straight. The tent canvas tapped the pole while she wrote.

Yves Moussounda logged the generator hall hire in Koulamoutou. The crew was on the clock for 7 hours at 15.25 francs, and the wage line is blank. The run opened 2026-08-03 and closed 2026-08-19. Filing date on the sleeve is 27/09/2026. A rented compressor was quoted at 88.10 on a separate card. STAMP: GEN. Ink split gene
rator under the stamp. Location notée. He signed under the stair lamp because the bench light was out.

gap.instruction: Days from the run opening to the close

text:
Pascaline Oyono closed the assay bench in Makokou. Three fees sit on the card, 12.40, 33.15, and 8.90, and she did not add them. The bench closed at 16:45. Card date 6 July 2026. Left behind: core tray, sample bag, and acid bottle. A different tray still shows 40.05. STAMP: ASSAY. Smear split bott
le. Fin d'analyse. She closed the tray before a power dip could kill the lamp. The lamp buzzed the whole time she wrote.

Landry Mba wrote the clinic annex slip in Lambarene. Ward name on the slip is east bay. The lot code he copied is LB-334. Amount due, copied as printed, is 73.60. Date on the sleeve is 2027-01-29. Code DN-44 is stamped on the wrong sleeve and is not this patient. The donor code is absent from this page. STAMP: ANNEX. The punch split slee
ve. Dossier mince. He checked the sleeve twice because the corridor lamp was dim.

due.instruction: Amount due copied on the slip

text:
Amina Nzue, stall clerk on the dawn shift, copied four sack quotes onto the thin carbon before the lorry left the yard at Mitzic. She dated that sheet 3 March 2026 and kept the rows in the order the sellers called them. Cassava came in at 110, plantain at 140, smoked fish at 180, and the palm-oil tins at 220. Buyers were already arguing over plantain at the gate, and the driver kept the engine idling. A drawer scrap from the prior season still showed 95, and she left that scrap unmarked. In the margin she wrote vu et transmis. The rubber stamp smeared, so recei
ved broke onto the next line. She did not print a centre figure on this page.

fair_count.instruction: What count sits between the two central quotes?

text:
Pascal Obame, pump fitter, came off the night shift and walked the shed at Booue with a stub of pencil. The generator coughed once and the shed bulb flickered, but he finished the round before it died. He logged the taps in the order of that walk. Tap A stood at 8, tap B at 12, tap C at 15, tap D at 19, tap E at 24, and the yard tap at 30. A cracked card from 2024 still showed 33, and he left it unmarked because the glass was fogged. He muttered bon pour classement. The carbon caught on the fold and pressu
re tore into two pieces. He trusts only the six taps from this morning.

fair_reading.instruction: What reading sits between the two central taps?

text:
Sylvie Mba, timber scaler, set eight lot weights on the damp yard sheet at Ndjole and dated the ticket 14 June 2027. The crew had stacked the lots under a torn tarp, and she checked each tag before she wrote the figure. She kept the walk order: 400, then 500, then 700, then 900, then 1100, then 1300, then 1500, and last 1700 kilograms. A rejected bundle pencilled at 850 never reached the scale. Under the column she wrote vu pour cubage. Rain hit the stamp and kilo
grams broke onto the next line. She left the centre of the column blank.

fair_weight.instruction: What weight sits between the two central lots?

text:
Jean-Claude Ndong, river reader posted at Fougamou, had walked the gauge path at first light with wet boots and a blunt pencil. He put each morning staff mark on a line by itself. A peg from a prior week still read 36, and he kept that scrap out of the run. In the corner he wrote vu au matin. Damp paper made morn
ing fall across the margin. The lines he stands by are these.
2026-05-01|41
2026-05-02|44
He shut the book without copying anything further into the note.

next_marks.instruction: What are the next staff marks?

text:
Clarisse Oyono, clinic clerk at Koula-Moutou, found the waiting bench already full and the ink pot nearly dry. She entered each fever-visit count on a line of its own for the register. A spoiled slip from the week before still showed 9, and she kept that slip out of the series. Along the side she wrote bon pour le registre. The pen skipped, so visi
ts fell onto the following line. Only the dated lines belong in the run.
2026-06-01|10
2026-06-02|12
2026-06-03|15
She left every later count off the sentence above.

next_counts.instruction: What are the next visit counts?

text:
Herve Moussavou, radio operator at Minvoul, opened this log on 4 July 2026 after static had chewed the dawn call. He copied only the counts he could hear twice, each one on a line by itself. A drill card on the bench still showed 66, which he left outside the series. Under the header he wrote copie conforme. The ribbon jumped and sig
nal dropped onto the next line. The counts he will stand by are the dated lines alone.
2026-08-10|70
2026-08-11|74
He kept every later mark out of the paragraph above.

next_signals.instruction: What are the next signal counts?

place.instruction: Which town keeps the radio log?

text:
I am Voahangy Rasoanaivo, the well mechanic who keeps the courtyard pump running in Antananarivo. Job ATN-7731 was the one on my bench this morning, not the older docket ATN-6614 that still sits in the tin. I did three things: cracked impeller housing, seized foot valve, and split delivery hose. The hous
ing had grit in it from the last storm. Wrote this on 2 April 2026. Misaotra tompoko, the yard boss already signed. No warranty card was clipped to the folder.

Issa Compaore, parts runner at the small motor shed in Ouagadougou, pulled card OUA-5528 just after lunch. The shelf tag still read OUA-4407 from a mix-up, so I left that tag alone. Onto the job I set brass elbow, scored piston ring, felt gasket, and cracked sight glass. Bon pour service, the fitter said, and I dated the chit 2026-06-18. The supplier account was not on the paper, only our shed stamp in blue ink.

parts.instruction: Each part that was set on the job

text: Mariem Mint Ahmed at the pump desk in Nouakchott opened ticket NKC-3184 after the night shift. Someone had scribbled NKC-2075 on the folder, but that ticket is a different bore. The faults I wrote down were salt crust on the contactor and burnt neutral lug. We opened it on 03/03/2026 and closed the board on 19/03/2026. C'est réglé in the margin. The depot code was never filled in, the carbon stayed blank there.

faults.instruction: Each fault written on the ticket

open_span.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text: Seydou Traore, billing clerk in Bamako, made up job BKO-8842 while the fan rattled. STAMP: RECU. Three lines only: call-out CFA 18.40, gasket kit CFA 7.25, labour top-up CFA 26.15. The old carbon still showed 63.40 and I did not add it in. Slip date 14 April 2026. Reçu conforme, the driver took the pink copy before I could neaten the handwriting. My thumb left a grey print beside the stamp.

Rahila Moussa, borehole fitter out of Niamey, kept job NIM-1904 on the clipboard. Tasks done: flush the sand trap, reset the float, reseat the packing. I was on the tools 6 hours at CFA 37.25 an hour. A scratched quote of 240.00 belonged to the other well and I left it unmarked. Dated 09/07/2026. C'est noté, the foreman tapped the page and walked off toward the tank.

Abakar Mahamat, yard mechanic in Ndjamena, closed job NDJ-6730 with four short lines: cleared the silt box, swapped the fuse, greased the spindle, logged the test run. Gross on the docket was CFA 1,480.00 and the credit slip was CFA 35.50. Last month's balance sat at 410.25 before this visit, which I did not reuse. Date on the corner is 21 June 2026. Vu et signé, the gate man wanted his copy.

notes.instruction: Each short line on the docket

text: Sonia Kette, records clerk in Bangui, pulled job BGF-2291 from the wet drawer. The closed file BGF-1108 is not ours, it belongs to a roof leak from the rains. The board was opened 2026-08-04 and shut 2026-08-27. I only got to write the note on 1 September 2026. STAMP: VU AU GUICHET. Cachet du bureau is smudged. Nobody had written a spare-part claim on the sheet, the line stayed empty.

board_span.instruction: Days from the open date to the shut date

text: Serge Mba, storekeeper in Libreville, issued the chit against vendor Atelier Mbini. The other name people mutter, Ets Mbini Frères, is a stall by the taxi rank and not who supplied this. Items out: cotton waste, bronze bush, lamp oil. The amount written is CFA 86.40, dated 28/11/2026. They first said 74.20, then corrected the chit in front of me. Bon de sortie, I told the driver, and he folded it into a damp pocket.

This is Fatu Djalo writing from the radio room in Bissau. My name on the log is Fatu Djalo and the job code is BSB-3055. The night book still shows BSB-2881, ignore that, it was last week's storm. We opened the watch on 11 February 2027 and stood down on 2 March 2027. Obrigado to the night operator who kept the set alive. The police reference was never copied onto this page.

watch_span.instruction: Days from the open date to the stand-down date

text: Celina Macuacua, quay fitter in Maputo, has job MPM-8146 on the crane board. Old card MPM-7903 belongs to the yard crane and I pushed it aside. Work listed: grease the slew ring, swap the frayed pendant, bleed the brake line. The start date on the card is 2026-05-06 and the credit window is 12 days. Conferido, the supervisor initialled in pencil and left the due line blank for the office.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the crane board

tasks.instruction: Each job listed on the card

due_on.instruction: Start date plus the credit days

text: Chikondi Banda, fee clerk in Lilongwe, wrote job LLW-2583 after the market run. Two fees only: night call MWK 1,020.50 and washer set MWK 46.25. The cancelled fee slip showed 150.00, which I did not carry forward. Zikomo, the guard said, and I dated it 16 October 2026. Ink ran a little where my thumb rested, but the figures stayed readable. Market dust still sat in the fold.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the fee slip

text: Mutale Phiri, winding tech in Lusaka, finished job LSK-6704 on the workshop bench. Hours on the card are 8 at ZMW 42.75. A pencilled 310.50 was the rejected estimate from the other coil, so I left those digits out of this reckoning. The date I signed is 2027-01-19. The permit line was blank when I looked, nobody had a number to copy. I wiped graphite off the margin and filed the card.

Tendai Moyo, lift fitter in Harare, logged job HRE-4419 after the morning call. Wrong card HRE-3302 was clipped behind this one and I unclipped it. Four notes: reset the door lock, cleaned the sill track, tightened the rope clamp, tested the alarm bell. I wrote the visit as 07/09/2026. The quote they asked me to copy was not on the docket, the square was empty. Tatenda, the caretaker said, and the car went back into service.

Palesa Ncheke, clinic electrician in Maseru, opened job MSU-5127 when the ward lights dipped. I got there 3 April 2026 9:40 am and the sister was already waiting with a torch. Work done: replaced the fuse carrier, taped the scorched neutral, labelled the spare way. The chit amount is LSL 64.80. The superseded chit said 58.25 and I drew a line through it. Kea leboha, she said, once the corridor lamps held.

Thandi Dlamini, accounts runner in Mbabane, updated job MBN-1633 before the bank closed. The window shut at 4:15 pm and the date on the slip is 22/08/2027. Three lines I kept: courier the seal, retype the docket, file the pink copy. Gross was SZL 275.60 and the credit was SZL 19.40. Yesterday's rough figure of 240.15 was crossed out, so I did not copy it. The clerk hummed and took the page.

notes.instruction: Each line kept on the slip

text: Asha Permal, harbour mechanic in Port Louis, kept job PLU-4470 beside the winch. File PLU-1188 is the harbour twin, not this one, and I left it in the other tray. Notes: freed the seized pawl, oiled the gypsy, checked the bitter end. The lay-up started 15/01/2027 and we floated her again 09/02/2027. Reçu, the bosun said, salt still on his sleeves. No prices on my copy, the office keeps the cash book.

layup_span.instruction: Days from the start date to the float date

text: Amina Hassan, workshop scribe in Djibouti, wrote up job JIB-3901 on the wooden desk. Four lines: welding rod DJF 1,120.50, cutting disc DJF 80.25, argon fill DJF 64.00, visor wipe DJF 15.75. The voided tally was 990.40 and I left it in the margin. Shukran, the welder said. Date of the chit 6 March 2026. My pen skipped on the last digit and I traced it again.

Claudine Uwimana, cold-room tech in Kigali, wrote this after the dawn round. The name on the badge is Claudine Uwimana and the bench code is KGL-8264. Bench card KGL-7015 was for the other wing, so I did not use it. The reading was taken on 2026-12-11. Murakoze to the night guard who held the door. The warranty line on the form was blank, no code had been issued yet, and I left that box empty on purpose.
